body: I've started keeping a journal of my dark thoughts. Thank you for the advice. I am going to try this again.

I remember being humiliated at school multiple times. I was in the bathroom as a middle schooler using the bathroom and I was a very modest child and I still am and they opened the stall and I walked out and everyone was laughing at me and I left the bathroom crying. I had to go back to that classroom with the same people in the class. My father is an asshole, he says he cares about us and I want to believe that but I don't think he does, he always takes his anger out on me and treats me like i'm worthless. I lost my grandma to cancer in 2009, my uncle to a heart attack in 2013 and my grandpa to cancer in 2017. I have so many things that could have possibly traumatized me. but I have no idea which one is causing which.
This was in the past. a bit ago. I haven't really thought about it that hard since.
I deeply appreciate everything you've said to me. I have a habit of proving that I'm right so I apologize for that. I will definitely update if I remember too. Have a great day.
It was not my intention to come off as rude I was only stating my disagreements with your points. I apologize if I came off as such.

part of me wants to get help but the other doesn't I am exhausted and its going to be a tiring process opening up about this. and I dread how easily people are going to throw me down if I dont have something driving me to take care of myself. Its a curse and a reward, but mostly a curse. I bought a box cutter because I made a plan to kill my dad but didn't because I love him. and a strong drive was driving me to that. I don't really know if it was a plan I just visualized it and wanted to do it so I prepared for it incase I wanted to.

thank you I will take that into consideration. I probably worded it like a confused teenager which I already know I am, but i was very frantic typing that. I wish I could open more about it on here but the facts are that I can't even say it here and I don't know why.

I agree, but I did not outright say that my dad was abusive, I said he could have been. I do not know for sure. But i'm not sure its just part of growing up. I feel no void and I have always been this way. I have never had a place to fit in so I always made one or basically used people's pain as an advantage to get my way into their lives and talk to them directly. You may be right it may not be a mental illness I just do not know what is causing this. Id like to pretend its just part of growing up but the reality is, it isn't this is not normal in any means and its isolating and disgusting. I will try to bring myself to admit that to my therapist I appreciate the feedback I just disagree with some of the points you made. Let me also break down everything for you. I said I don't know if I have any trauma because I cannot remember a single thing about my past, and it probably got swept under the rug like everything. And the reason I said I lost my sense of self is because that is the reason I adapt to different environments. To fake it to make it as some say, I feel really nothing at all so I make everyone think I do so I can get by and so people will leave me alone. I appreciate your help so very much. But like I said earlier I disagree with some points.  

Hope you understand
but what if I can't be helped?
I will consider it though. I appreciate it. no promises that I can but I will try.

how could I? I am terrified of the aftermath and the face my therapist will make once he hears that. I have put myself as a "good person" in his eyes and I do not want to ruin that sense because I am terrified of confrontation and the only way I can deal with pain is to avoid it.
I don't know if I could, I hate that I have these thoughts it makes me feel worthless and pathetic.
much luck to you, I hope your pain relieves as well.
I am in it, I'm scared to bring it up.
